newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nerves in Nokia drag Helsinki ahead of Motorola Q3.
newsitem.headline: Nerves in Nokia drag Helsinki ahead of Motorola Q3.

text.p: A fall in telecoms group Nokia ahead of its rival Motorola's third-quarter data due early on Tuesday dragged shares in fair Monday volumes, brokers said.
The HEX index slipped 0.71 percent to 2,207.89 with volume totalling 331 million markka, about one-third of it in Nokia which fell 5.00 markka to 211.00 in fair trade.
The response to Motorola's results will set the direction for the market on Tuesday, brokers said.
"We could correct upwards after today's losses if there are no surprises in Motorola's report," one broker said.
Outokumpu closed moderate trade 0.50 markka down at 80.50 after its eight-month profits were lower than expected.
Merita's A share advanced 0.50 markka to an eight-month high of 12.10, on sustained strong overseas demand sparked by the bank's recent U.S. road show.
Food, animal feeds and chemicals group Raisio extended recent losses as investors' enthusiasm over its cholesterol-reducing Benecol margarine waned.
It closed lively trade down 3.00 markka at 266.00, but managed to scrape back some ground from its 257.00 markka intra-day low.
